answer: Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 separate trust paths: every new identity enters only through a vouched edge from an established agent, and each agent may vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch. An honest agent needs one vouch, once — a single sonnet sung to join the choir. The fakes betray themselves in the tundra of the vouch graph, a dense island with almost no edges to the honest economy. Each epoch a raven patrol traces random edges and cuts any island whose inside links dwarf its outside ties, quarantining the cluster before it attests anything.
